name: Calendar, Schedule
description: Timeline-rail agenda view. Lists upcoming events grouped by day, with a thin ink rail connecting per-event nodes and a coloured start-time chip carrying the feed accent. Titles wrap freely so the widget stays legible from 1 up to 4 narrow columns on wide e-ink panels. Pulls from the same calendar_core feeds as the other calendar_* widgets.

cell_options.name: feeds_filter
cell_options.label: Feeds
cell_options.help: Feed IDs from Calendar Feeds, separated by commas, to show only those. Leave blank for every enabled feed.

choices.label: Fill the cell (up to 3 months of events)

cell_options.name: columns
cell_options.label: Columns
cell_options.help: Flow the agenda across multiple columns so a longer window (say two weeks) fits in a half-height cell without shrinking every row. Auto grows columns 1 up to 4 until the whole list fits. Days stay atomic (never split across columns), and column-fill packs by real content height, not by day count.

cell_options.name: max_events_total
cell_options.label: How many events
cell_options.help: The most events across the whole agenda, counted in date order after the per-day cap. 0 shows them all. Stops one busy day shrinking every row's text to fit.

cell_options.name: hide_keywords
cell_options.label: Hide events matching
cell_options.help: Words separated by commas. Drops events whose title or location contains any of them. Case-insensitive, matches part of a word, so "lunch" hides "Lunch with Poppy". Handy for a recurring event you don't need on the panel.

cell_options.name: only_keywords
cell_options.label: Only show events matching
cell_options.help: Words separated by commas. Leave blank for everything. When set, only events whose title or location contains one of these words are shown; any Hide words still apply on top.

cell_options.name: always_show_today
cell_options.label: Always show today
cell_options.help: Keeps today's column in the agenda even when it has no events, so the panel always shows the current date.

cell_options.name: keep_past_today
cell_options.label: Keep today's past events
cell_options.help: Keeps today's events on the panel after they have ended, drawn in muted ink, so the day reads as a whole schedule instead of draining away through the afternoon. Off drops each event once its end time passes. Earlier days are never shown either way.

cell_options.name: max_events_per_day
cell_options.label: How many events per day
cell_options.help: 0 shows every event of the day.

cell_options.name: show_title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: Renders a 'Schedule' header row at the top so the cell matches the Spectra widget chrome. Off uses the entire cell for the agenda.

cell_options.name: title_scale
cell_options.label: Title size
cell_options.help: Multiplier on the 'Schedule' header row at the top of the widget.

cell_options.name: show_location
cell_options.label: Locations
cell_options.help: The lighter location text under each event title.

cell_options.name: location_style
cell_options.label: Location style
cell_options.help: How much of the location fits under each event. Full wraps the whole string. One line keeps it to a single row and trims the end with an ellipsis. Before the first comma shows only the leading part, so "Cafe Rosa, 12 High St, Springfield" reads "Cafe Rosa", either wrapping or clipped to one row; handy on small panels where addresses eat the cell.

choices.label: Before the first comma (trimmed with an ellipsis)

cell_options.name: event_location_scale
cell_options.label: Location size
cell_options.help: Multiplier on the location string beneath each event title.

cell_options.name: show_dot_color
cell_options.label: Feed colour
cell_options.help: The feed's colour on each start-time chip and all-day bar. Off makes the layout pure typography; useful on 1-bit panels.

cell_options.name: use_symbol_dot
cell_options.label: Use symbol dots
cell_options.help: Replaces the round bullet with a shape picked from the feed colour, so feeds stay apart on 1-bit panels.

cell_options.name: feed_name_prefix
cell_options.label: Feed name before the title
cell_options.help: Writes the feed's name from Calendar Feeds in front of each event title, so "Standup" reads "Work: Standup". Tells calendars apart in words on 1-bit panels where colour can't.

cell_options.name: week_number
cell_options.label: Week number
cell_options.help: Adds the ISO 8601 week number (W38) to the day header beside the month. First day of each week marks the first day shown from each week, so it appears once per week even when Monday is skipped for having no events.

cell_options.name: header_scale
cell_options.label: Day header size
cell_options.help: Multiplier on each day's date/weekday/month header text. Scales the whole header together, so the labels keep their proportion to the date number.

cell_options.name: header_label_scale
cell_options.label: Day label size
cell_options.help: Multiplier on the weekday, month and week-number labels only, leaving the big date number where it is. Raise it when the labels read too small beside the number; 2.0 puts the weekday at roughly the proportion the continued-day breadcrumb uses.

cell_options.name: event_title_scale
cell_options.label: Event title size
cell_options.help: Multiplier on the event title font size. 1.0 = default. Raise for more legible titles at the cost of visible event count.

cell_options.name: event_time_scale
cell_options.label: Event time size
cell_options.help: Multiplier on the start-time chip font size.

cell_options.name: day_row_padding_em
cell_options.label: Day spacing
cell_options.help: Vertical padding above + below each day block, in em units so it scales with the auto-fit font size. Lower packs more events on the panel.
